things that scream
international student
pt.1
Calling home on weekends with a time difference. Sunday morning for you, Sunday evening for them. Every international student knows that schedule.
A suitcase that never fully gets unpacked. Half your life lives in it, ready for the next trip home or the next weekend away.
Speaking three languages in one sentence. Your friends from everywhere end up mixing words until you invent your own language.
Cooking your mother's recipes from memory. They never taste exactly the same, but they make a small flat feel like home.
Learning about every country your friends come from. I do five minutes a day of history, art or science, and it makes those friendships deeper.
slides.texte_sophia: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. It makes those friendships deeper.

slides.texte_overlay: Cheap flights booked at 2am. Always checking prices, always planning the next adventure on a student budget. Always.
Friends who become family. When you're far from home, the people around you become your support system for life.
